note: Expanded API probe suite. Adds authorisation depth (signature, payload, alg=none, expiry, truncation), metric/level coverage including PRA and GB, filter handling, payload limits, content negotiation, information disclosure, method handling, plus in-script response-contract, arithmetic-consistency, determinism and concurrency phases. Security response headers cannot be inspected from inside the browser because CORS exposes only four headers to scripts; that check is recorded as a harness gap for curl/CI.

results.note: Market codes are case-sensitive: lowercase "us" returns 200 with zero rows and echoes retailUnitCode back as "us". Note this is the opposite of `level`, which is case-insensitive.

results.name: Uppercase level name is handled, not 500
results.note: Accepted: uppercase `level` returns full data. Combined with the case-sensitive retailUnitCode above, the two fields follow opposite rules - worth making consistent.
